>
[Searing Blade](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2870)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=604" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 242

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=386)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+2 greater striking [flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295) [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=31)_ has an ornate brass hilt and a blade shaped like stylized flames. When wielded, the blade projects illumination resembling shimmering firelight, emitting dim light in a 10-foot radius. 

**Activate—Shoot Fire** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You cast the [_ignition_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1565) cantrip from the sword as a 7th-rank arcane spell, using your melee attack modifier with _searing blade_ as your spell attack modifier.

</column>

Searing Blade (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 243

**Price** 13,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

This is a _+3 greater striking greater flaming longsword_. When you activate the sword to cast ignition, the spell is 9th rank. This weapon also has the Radiate Flames activation.

**Activate—Radiate Flames** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([aura](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=5), [concentrate](/Actions.aspx?ID=683), [fire](/Domains.aspx?ID=13)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** A 10-foot emanation of flame radiates from the _greater searing blade_ for 1 minute. All weapon and unarmed attacks by you and your allies within the area gain the effect of the [flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295) property rune.
